## Technology Stack
- Front-End: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), Bootstrap 5, Modern Responsive UI/UX
- Back-End: PHP 8.x, Python, Node.js, RESTful APIs, MVC Frameworks
- Database: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL
- CMS & E-Commerce: WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Custom E-commerce Engines
- Cloud & Hosting: Hostinger, AWS, cPanel/Linux Server Administration, SSL/TLS, WAF, Cloudflare CDN
- Analytics & Ad Tech: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Search Console, Meta Pixel, Google Ads API
